reserveReview.rationale: 2026-11-22 pinned renewal replacing the earlier invalid pre-deployment BSC block 0x6b4e24. Pinned reads at finalized BSC block 135105062 (hash 0xd17dd951447a985c059fe779e9059378fe6e9f69913f773c8fac7b10381c822d, 2026-11-22T15:43:09Z; cross-checked post-deployment at block 134557903, 2026-11-19T19:18:02Z) confirm sUSD1+ proxy 0x4f2760b32720f013e900dc92f65480137391199b delegates to verified UUPS implementation 0x972c27ee69b19d7648cef365700c22713a9a31fd. The contract is a custom OTF vault rather than ERC-4626 (totalAssets() reverts; verified ABI exposes underlying(), acceptUnderlying(), totalSupply(), getCurrentUnitNav(), portfolios(), and weights()). At block 135105062, underlying() returns BSC WLFI USD1 (0x8d0d...8b0d), acceptUnderlying() returns true for BSC USDT and BSC USDC, totalSupply() is 77,267,454.651691 sUSD1+ (18 decimals), getCurrentUnitNav() is 1.03559329 (implied BSC NAV $80,017,657.62), settlementPeriod() is 106, unsettledWithdrawShares() is 70,778.486922, and portfolios()/weights() route 100% of deposits to EOA 0x8fc570c84ee087c1102ed3f137db329980f08c4c (empty bytecode). Idle on-chain balances at block 135105062 are only 674.610814 USD1 (0.00084% of NAV) in the proxy and zero USDT/USDC; both 0x8fc5...8c4c and the unused usd1PlusVault 0xaefc...4867 hold zero USD1, USDT, and USDC. Lorenzo's vault detail and GraphQL APIs on 2026-11-22 confirm accepted deposits (USD1, USDT, USDC) and aggregatedTVL of $80,017,794.13 ($80,017,657.57 BSC plus $136.56 Ethereum), while detailedTVL reports only $516,590.27 (0.65% of TVL) across Binance/OKX/Bybit sub-accounts with an invalid Bybit API key and zero Cobo transit. Because >99.3% of backing sits in undisclosed off-chain RWA, CeFi quant, and DeFi sleeves with no dated issuer weights, the composition remains one explicit 100% fund-share basket at conservative high risk and probable confidence without a single-parent usd1-world-liberty-financial reserve link (consistent with owner ruling D26).
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pinned BSC vault state and idle balance reads at finalized block 135105062 (2026-11-22T15:43:09Z), verified sUSD1PlusVault source/ABI, Lorenzo vault detail and GraphQL APIs (2026-11-22), and issuer launch/redemption publications; strategy sleeve weights remain undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 100% strategy portfolio is not split among accepted USD1, USDT, and USDC deposits or the RWA, CeFi quantitative, and DeFi positions; only $674.61 USD1 sits idle in the BSC vault and $516,590.27 (0.65% of $80.02M TVL) appears in Lorenzo's partial detailedTVL exchange feed. Under owner ruling D26 reviewed on 2026-10-01, USD1 branding, underlying(), and USD1 settlement do not establish a measured single-parent USD1 reserve claim.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The OTF model is on-chain fundraising, off-chain execution, on-chain settlement: deposited funds leave the BNB Chain vault into strategy execution, and Lorenzo's own disclaimer states it 'does not manage user funds and is not responsible for the performance of any underlying strategy'. Current portfolios()/weights() reads identify one funding destination, and token-scoped detailedTVL identifies partial Binance, Bybit and OKX account equity. These are not a full asset-to-liability reconciliation or legal custody inventory; provider shares, account segregation, insolvency treatment and funding-wallet key custody remain undisclosed. Segregation remains unknown and no bankruptcy-remoteness structure is documented (recorded as none). Active deployment of vault assets into off-chain strategies is the disclosed design, recorded as permitted rehypothecation of the reserve. The prior June 2026 statement that the BSC implementation and upgrade authority were unresolved is superseded by the separate Mint Authority review: pinned 2026-10-01 reads identify implementation 0x972c27ee69b19d7648cef365700c22713a9a31fd, manager 0x507ec48ef26919a205a9f3b8aaf69532e20c0987 and the 2-of-3 Safe holding BOSS_ROLE, MANAGER_ROLE and CREATE_VAULT_ROLE. The March 2026 redemption guide now states a normal 3-6 day NAV settlement cycle, with possible extensions for large withdrawals or network congestion; the old 7-day minimum plus biweekly timing is not the current disclosed cadence.
